verdict.rationale: SvelteKit is Svelte's first-party application framework, documented on svelte.dev and scaffolded with the official `npx sv create`. It provides file-based routing: pages are created by adding files to `src/routes`, and it supports per-page rendering modes, SPA client-side rendering and preloading pages before navigation. Community users corroborate the routing structure in real projects, though one finds the folder-based layout/route hierarchy questionable. Missing for 10: routing ships as part of the SvelteKit meta-framework rather than a standalone router for plain Svelte apps, and the evidence does not detail route params, layouts or the programmatic navigation API.
